subject: Inbound intake — use-case matrix & three-slot availability
messages:
From: Olivia Martin <olivia@mallifty.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-12T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood — request demo / quick intro

Hi Vivek,

I signed up via the website earlier today and wanted to ask for a short demo next week. We're evaluating inference platforms for our recommendation engine (real-time reranks on product lists) and would like to understand latency/cost tradeoffs and what a pilot would look like.

High-level:
- Use case: real-time ranking + occasional batch embeddings for similarity
- Current traffic: ~1.2M requests/day, 10–40k concurrent users at peak
- Preferred timeline: pilot in 6–8 weeks, production within 4 months depending on results

Would appreciate a 30-minute walkthrough focused on perf and integration patterns. Can you share availability? I can also pull a small traffic sample if useful.

Thanks,
Olivia Martin
Head of ML, Mallifty
olivia@mallifty.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Martin <olivia@mallifty.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — request demo / quick intro

Hi Olivia — thanks for signing up and for the context. Monica (our solutions engineer) will join to cover integration details. A few quick qualification questions so we tailor the demo:

1) Primary KPI: is latency for user-facing reranks the top metric, or is cost/throughput equally important?
2) Target p50/p95 latency SLO (ms) and acceptable cold-start?
3) Typical input sizes (tokens) for your rerank requests and for batch embedding jobs?
4) Do you need VPC/private deployment for the pilot, or is hosted ok for now?
5) Any compliance requirements (SOC2, data locality) we should be aware of?

Proposed 30-min slots:
- Tue 16 Apr, 10:00–10:30 PDT
- Wed 17 Apr, 14:00–14:30 PDT
- Thu 18 Apr, 08:30–09:00 PDT

If none of those fit, tell me 2–3 windows that do and we'll accommodate. If you can attach a 24–48 hour traffic snapshot (anonymized), that helps us bring throughput/quant recommendations.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
SDR / Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
From: Olivia Martin <olivia@mallifty.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-12T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — request demo / quick intro

Thanks Vivek — answers below, and attaching a small traffic snapshot.

> 1) Primary KPI
Latency is top (p95 under 200ms ideally), but cost matters — we can't exceed a tight ops budget for the pilot.

> 2) Target SLO
p50 ~ 40–60ms, p95 ~ 150–200ms. Cold-starts are ok up to 1s for rare requests.

> 3) Input sizes
Rerank requests: typically 200–450 tokens (prompt + candidates). Batch embeddings: 512 tokens average.

> 4) Deployment
Hosted is fine for pilot; we may ask about VPC for production.

> 5) Compliance
SOC2 is required; we have EU customers but pilot will be US-based.

Slots: Tue 16 Apr at 10:00 works for me. Please invite our engineering lead (cc: eng-leads@mallifty.com).

Attaching: traffic_snapshot.csv (anonymized rows, sample of 48h)

Best,
Olivia
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Martin <olivia@mallifty.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, eng-leads@mallifty.com
Date: 2028-04-13T14:05:00-07:00

Perfect — thanks for the details and the sample file. I've booked Tue, 16 Apr 2028, 10:00–10:30 PDT and sent a calendar invite to you and your engineering lead. Monica will cover integration and throughput tuning; I'll run the pilot scoping items.

Prep for the call (short):
- We'll review the traffic snapshot and map to batching/kv-cache recommendations.
- Please have someone from infra/engineering on the call to confirm SSO/VPC needs.
- If you can paste one example request payload (anonymized) into the meeting notes that would help us size the KV cache.

Follow-ups after the demo: we typically provide a short mutual action plan (pilot scope, success metrics, timeline, and sample cost estimate).

Attachments on our side: calendar invite stub (sent).

Look forward to it — see you Tue.

Thanks,
Vivek
SDR / Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
